verdict.rationale: Viam documents public APIs for machine control and fleet management, including org, location, machine, permission and fragment management. It provides SDKs in Python, Go, C++, TypeScript and Flutter, a CLI that can call any machine API method with JSON in and out, and a dedicated guide for driving machines from an AI agent. A community report independently confirms the whole system is built on open-source gRPC. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/REST spec (all OpenAPI probe paths returned 404; the API surface is gRPC/SDK-based instead).
